stem: MetroPlay runs latency-sensitive game matchmaking near city users but keeps account-management services in a full AWS Region. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Place matchmaking services in a Local Zone near end users
Place account-management databases in a Wavelength Zone only
Move both workloads to a single Outposts rack
Place all components in one Availability Zone in the Region
Keep core account-management services in the parent Region

rationale: Local Zones are designed for low-latency workloads near users, which fits matchmaking response requirements. Keeping account-management services in the parent Region preserves access to broader Regional services and operations. Moving account-management databases to Wavelength-only placement conflicts with the requirement to keep that tier in full Regional environment. A single Outposts rack changes the operating model and does not match the stated architecture target. Placing all components in one AZ removes the intended distributed placement strategy.
